title: Honua Samples Coverage Snapshot v1
description: Shape of samples-coverage.v1.json, written by scripts/generate-samples-coverage.mjs and uploaded as a CI artifact on trunk builds (honua-io/honua-samples#5). This is the producer snapshot honua-evidence's capability matrix ingests: per canonical capability key, the sample(s) that demonstrate it. Capability keys with zero covering samples are absent -- never padded with an empty array -- so the matrix can render that honestly as a gap.

capabilities.description: Keyed by canonical capability key (validated against the same key list as samples/*/sample.json -- see scripts/lib/capability-keys.mjs). Only keys covered by at least one sample manifest are present.

id.description: Matches the sample's samples/<id>/ directory name and sample.json `id`.

url.description: Gallery URL: https://samples.honua.io/<id> (domain decided, DNS pending as of this writing).

edition.description: Copied from the sample manifest's `edition` (defaults to 'community' when the manifest omits it, per schemas/sample.v1.schema.json).

lastRun.description: Present only when results/run-results.v1.json (the latest scripts/run-samples.mjs envelope) has a matching entry for this sample id -- i.e. the sample is status="active" and has been executed at least once. Absent for draft samples or samples never yet run.

at.description: The run envelope's generatedAt timestamp (run-results.v1.json has no per-sample timestamp, only durationMs).
